title: devx: re-triage objectui#7953's ported `.claude/hooks/**` files against the per-file `ref`, per file rather than as one batch — item 3 of objectui#8385
body:
Split out of objectui#8385 by its triage (comment 5582520495), which narrowed that card to item 1 (the prose fix, landed separately). This is item 3. objectui#8385 is not addressed here.

## The blocker objectui#7953 recorded is structural and is gone

objectui#7953 (closed) recorded that ported `.claude/hooks/**` files could not be registered because they did not exist upstream at the then ledger-wide ref at all — one global `upstream.ref` meant every entry had to share one revision.

objectui#8288 retired that field. Measured on `origin/main` `da5e4f69e`, `scripts/upstream-port-pin.json` already carries `.claude/hooks/guard-main-checkout.selftest.sh` at a *different* ref from the other two entries, and `check-upstream-port-parity` reports all three green `each at its own pinned ref (2 distinct: ...)`. A per-file ref can therefore name, for each hook file, a revision at which that file exists.

## What is still true, and is the extra cost here

`.claude/**` IS governed surface. Measured: `governedPathsIn(['.claude/hooks/guard-main-checkout.selftest.sh'])` returns the `claude-tree` surface (`.claude/**` — "the agent instruction tree (skills, hooks, settings)"). `--resync` refuses to write a governed file without `--rewrite-governed-file` (`RESYNC_GOVERNED_FLAG` in `scripts/check-upstream-port-parity.mjs`). That is a flag, not a blocker — the CHECK path is not governed at all — but it means this work touches governed surface and may need a maintainer decision.

## The ask

Decide registration **per file**, not as one all-or-nothing batch — that all-or-nothing shape was itself an artefact of the single global ref. For each of objectui#7953's hook files: does it exist upstream at some ref, and are its divergences declarable as exact text pairs with a `why`?

objectui#7953 also recorded that those files carry EXECUTABLE drift from upstream, not just cosmetic drift, so per-file the honest answer may be "declare the divergences" or may be "do not pin, and say why" — both are outcomes this card accepts.

No assignee. Note for triage: the fix landing point includes `.claude/**`, which may put this in `domain:skills` rather than `domain:devx`.
